content: {"episode_id": "ep-05075", "cpt": "93271", "denial_carc": "CO-97", "necessity_paragraph": "The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
